title: Steamed Nutty Rice Bowl
description: A simple and healthy bowl filled with nutty steamed rice and fragrant steamed vegetables. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Fragrant Fresh Herbs
ingredients.notes: such as basil, cilantro or mint

instructions: Rinse the rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes. Drain and steam the rice in a steamer or a pot with a steamer basket.
Steam the carrots and peas in a steamer or a pot with a steamer basket until tender.
In a small bowl, mix the fish sauce with the fragrant fresh herbs.
To assemble the bowl, place the steamed rice in the bottom, then add the steamed carrots and peas.
Garnish with the herb fish sauce mixture and serve immediately.
